title: Whistle Blows as Qom–China Export Train Departs / Qom Bitumen Heads for China
text:
Whistle Blows as Qom–China Export Train Departs / Qom Bitumen Heads for China"

"🔆🔅QOM, October 28, 2026 -- In line with efforts to facilitate exports and develop the rail fleet, the whistle of the export train from Qom to China has sounded, and Qom bitumen is now en route to China."

"A container export train from Qom Province was dispatched to China on the order of Akbar Behnamjoo, Governor of Qom, with the aim of developing rail transport and facilitating the export of manufactured goods produced in the province."

"The train is carrying Qom bitumen to China.
